rules.statement: The court should exercise discretion to grant leave to appeal when the matter in dispute is of great general importance, public importance, or otherwise a substantial matter.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think it can be said that the question in this case falls within the condition of great general importance or of public importance. The most that can be said in regard to it is that it concerns a question of intestate succession arising in Kandyan law in certain circumstances that are more of uncommon than common occurrence. Nor, is it, otherwise, a matter of such a substantial character as would justify us to give a leave."
